name: BDKiPartSearchTools
description: Component search, symbol/footprint/3D library importer (LCSC, DigiKey, Würth Elektronik), and smart priced BOM tool by Berkay Degirmenci.
description_full:
BDKiPartSearchTools (by Berkay Degirmenci) allows you to search electronic components from online suppliers (LCSC/EasyEDA, DigiKey, Würth Elektronik, etc.) and import them directly into KiCad libraries (.kicad_sym, .kicad_mod, .step, .wrl) with automatic sym-lib-table and fp-lib-table registration.

Features:
- Live 2D Schematic Symbol and PCB Footprint preview before import
- Native support for Würth Elektronik official KiCad library and GitHub repository
- Automatic category-based or unified library organization (Global or Project scope)
- Embeds supplier and engineering metadata (MPN, Manufacturer, Supplier Part #, Datasheet, Supplier URLs) into symbols
- Smart BOM & Live Pricing/Stock manager supporting Engineering CSV, JLCPCB PCBA BOM, and DigiKey Bulk Upload CSV (dynamic live pricing/stock on demand)
- Accessible from both Schematic Editor (Eeschema) and PCB Editor (Pcbnew) in KiCad 9/10, and PCB Editor in KiCad 8.
- Multi-language support: Automatically detects KiCad language (English / Turkish) or user-selectable.
- Note: User interface is provided in Turkish and English.
